name: Evil's Media Encoding Platform 5.0 Milestone 1 Update Light
notes: Completes the GitHub update status light for EvildeadNZ/EMO.
Shows installed and latest versions plus last-check time in the tooltip and status dialog.
Clicking the update indicator opens a detailed status panel with Check Again and Open GitHub actions.
When a newer build is available, the status panel offers one-click download, validation, install and restart.
Adds explicit checking, downloading, current, available and failure states with readable explanations.
